description: Training script for DETR object detection model using detectron2 framework, including custom trainer class, optimizer setup, and main execution logic.

classes.name: Trainer
classes.description: Custom trainer class extending DefaultTrainer for DETR, with methods for building evaluator, train loader, and optimizer.

methods.name: build_evaluator
methods.description: Creates an evaluator for a dataset, defaulting to COCOEvaluator.

methods.name: build_train_loader
methods.description: Builds the training data loader, using DetrDatasetMapper if architecture is 'Detr'.

methods.name: build_optimizer
methods.description: Sets up the optimizer with parameter groups, supports gradient clipping, and handles different optimizer types.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Creates and configures the training setup, merging configs and performing basic setup.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for training or evaluation, initializes configuration, model, and runs training or evaluation.
